location_exception_reason: Prefabricated houses are factory-manufactured products with nationwide distribution and installation capability; location in title is a seller attribute (where they operate), not a product attribute that changes buyer decision-making. Prefab houses are not GI-tagged or regionally origin-defined.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Builder) in prefab house titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Prefabricated House Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
